text:
maria - marketing lead: Heads up: were prepping a short customer portrait for Neils team. Goal: publish gated one-pager + 1 blog excerpt + webinar mention. Need interview, release, and asset handoff this week.
sam - producer: I can run a 25m interview Thurs 11am PT. Ill capture audio and rough draft a 2-paragraph excerpt live.
neil (customer): Thurs works. I can share two slides with metrics before we talk (throughput, cost delta, p99 latency).
jin - product marketer: Please capture exact before/after baselines so we can make a tiny chart for the excerpt. Also want two headline approaches.
lex - legal: Quick note: send a one-line quote draft and the release form post-interview. If Neil signs off on the numbers we can publish exact figures; otherwise use "about" language.
tara - design: Ill slot a hero image and a gated PDF template. Need final approved quote + logo usage by Fri noon to build the PDF.
owen - sales: Routing: anyone who downloads the PDF should be added to the inbound AE queue and get the webinar invite sequence. Maria, please share campaign name.
workflow-bot: Task created: "Field portrait PDF - add downloads to owen.sales"  due 2026-04-10
maria - marketing lead: Action list: 1) Sam run interview Thu 11am PT. 2) Neil provide metric slides pre-call. 3) Sam deliver transcript + two quote variants within 24h. 4) Lex clear quotes within 24h. 5) Tara finalize PDF by Fri noon. 6) Maria create SFDC campaign and share name. 7) Owen confirm AE nurture. Anything missing?
sam - producer: Ill also draft a 2-slide SDR playbook from the interview for Owen.
lex - legal: Will prioritize quick turnaround.
neil (customer): Happy to sign the release if wording matches my slides.
maria - marketing lead: Great. Ill post the calendar invite after legal signoff and lock the publish window. :sparkles:
